verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Devin works with repositories: it indexes them, queries private repos with authentication, and reaches internal Git hosts over VPN. None of it documents how repository access is granted, and nothing shows a one-click install or a GitHub/GitLab app connection flow. Repo indexing and environment configuration are related features, not the one-click repository access the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup
